::: {.intro}
These notes develop asymptotic inference tools for online experimentation platforms.
Experiment data are modeled using a fixed-potential-outcomes framework with independent, sequential treatment assignments.
To support reliable inference across a wide range of potential outcome configurations, the statistical procedures provide coverage guarantees that hold uniformly over the parameter space.

:::
